name: Han Feizi
shortBio: Foremost theoretician of Chinese Legalism (Fajia) who synthesized institutional law (fa), administrative statecraft (shu), and political positional power (shi) into a realist philosophy of state authority.
centralQuestion: How can a ruler secure public order and state strength through institutional law and objective administrative mechanisms rather than personal moral virtue?

keyWorks.title: Han Feizi
keyWorks.description: Magnum opus synthesizing the core tenets of Chinese Legalism, analyzing the two handles of reward and punishment, administrative secrecy, and political realism.
